description:
Use this when the user asks which Indian stocks are in the NSE futures-and-options ban period today.

Returns the securities in the F&O ban period on the latest day NSE published the list, with that date in `ban_date`. It takes no arguments. An empty list means nothing is in ban that day. To check one stock together with its open interest use get_derivatives_positioning.
name: get_fno_ban_list
title: F&O ban list
